scores.notes: The flamingo under Alice's arm has two necks and heads (one curling up over her shoulder, a second swung low as the mallet at lower left). The card soldiers carry index numerals, including a legible '6' on the hearts card at lower right.
Ezekiel speaks with arm outstretched over a valley of dry bones under rays of light; no figure in the light, his closed book is unmarked, paint runs to all edges.
Saul reels inside a shaft of light from the sky with companions shielding their eyes and Damascus behind. Ragged white paper shows along the left, right and bottom edges (accepted).
Daniel is hauled up on a rope past calm lions while the king rejoices at the rim; the scroll case and stones carry no marks. White paper shows at the top-left and other corners (accepted).

The seraphim above the altar are ordinary two-winged robed angels with faces and feet uncovered, not the six-winged, face- and feet-covering creatures the verse specifies, so the visionary-creature rule is broken. The Lord is only light and smoke; the white at top centre is painted glow, not bare paper.
A boar with clearly cloven hooves is the subject, with Moses gesturing to it beside Aaron and onlookers in the camp; they are the law's hearers, not counted as extra. No God figure, no lettering.
Three generations read clearly: seated elder, kneeling father and toddler sharing a loaf by a stone house. White paper shows along the top, left and right edges (accepted).

An elder clasps hands with a grey-bearded man while a boy stands by, reading as Obed, Jesse and David; a second man and an old woman stand behind as household. Clasped hands are sound and paint reaches the edges.

Hatherley, hand bandaged, points excitedly at the burning white house with fire engines, rose bushes and gravel drive while Holmes and the crowd look on. Helmet badges only, no lettering; Holmes is a generic gaunt period type, not counted as a likeness.

A white question mark is painted in the air above Wilson's head (left of centre, by the window curtain), a real readable glyph. Otherwise the scene is right: Holmes closing the door on Watson while the stout red-haired client half rises; papers and clock carry only unreadable marks.

It shows the letter's author writing on a scroll at a table among listeners in a Greek city, with no mirror, dim reflection or face-to-face image at all. Faint rows of unreadable writing marks sit on the open scroll sheet at centre.
Peter clutches his coat around a bare torso as he leaps from the boat, the young disciple points to Jesus on the shore, and others hold the net of fish. No lettering, anatomy sound.

Hezekiah directing temple works reads well, but the open scrolls carry ink marks: the plan on the table at lower right has a row of glyph-like strokes and the held scroll a grid with small character-like marks. They are small and unreadable; the wash reaches the edges.
No pig appears anywhere: only Moses and Aaron looking up at the cloud over the tabernacle in the camp. The cloud is not figure-shaped; white paper shows at the top, left and right edges (accepted).
Fire streaks from a dark cloud onto burning walled cities on the plain. Ragged white paper patches show along the left edge and bottom-left (accepted).
Bald Elisha walks up the road while youths from the city point and jeer behind him. His hands are slightly soft but not malformed; no lettering.
People fill jars and sacks with coins and grain at a city gate while wisps of wind move through; Wisdom is not drawn as a figure. The pale top band is painted sky.
Job stands by the ash heap looking up into a whirlwind and rays of light with no figure in them. Ragged white paper shows along the left edge and bottom-left (accepted).
The father gestures as servants drape the robe on the ragged son, fit a ring and kneel with a sandal. Hands are sound; onlookers are household background.
A coal fire with fish and bread on the shore, Jesus beside it, the disciples coming in with the net. White paper shows along the left and right edges (accepted).
At night Peter steps off the bow toward Jesus standing on the water in the distance while the others watch from the boat. No lettering, figures sound.

The Caterpillar is given a bowler hat and a waistcoat that the text never gives it, against the rule that animals wear dress only where the text does. Its hookah is only a mouthpiece on a hose that loops back on itself with no vessel; Alice and the mushroom otherwise match.
Job with his staff by the ash heap and potsherds faces a whirlwind beyond the city wall; no figure in the storm, no lettering, painted to the edges.
Moses raises his rod at the rock as water gushes out, Aaron beside him, with people and flocks drinking. The breastplate shows gems only; small crowd figures are loose but not malformed.

An old man reads a scroll to women and children in a courtyard, a reciter of the genealogy rather than Obed, Jesse and David themselves. The open scroll at centre carries rows of unreadable writing marks.
The cloud rests on the tabernacle with the camp settled around it. Bare white paper frames all four edges (accepted).
An empty throne of flame on burning wheels under a column of cloud and light, side thrones and standing ranks, Daniel watching in front. No human shape occupies the throne; no lettering.
The servant carrying the robe at lower left has three legs: five feet show beneath the two servants. The scene itself is right, with the father, the ragged barefoot son, robe and sandals.

Newspapers on the table at lower right carry mastheads in legible letterforms (gibberish words, one upside down), and wall sheets carry print marks. Holmes pulls a moustached man in by the arm while a second Watson-like man with bowler and bag also stands in the doorway, one figure too many; white paper shows at the top, left and right edges (accepted).
Rephaiah kneels setting a stone in the wall with workers, mortar and baskets, Jerusalem behind. White paper shows along the bottom and sides (accepted).

Waves break into the swamped boat as disciples bail and hold the mast, Jesus asleep in the stern. A narrow ragged paper margin shows at the right edge beside the cliff and in gaps on the left (accepted); most white is foam.

Israelites with staffs and loaded donkeys set out across the plain from the mountain, cloud and radiance at its peak with no figure. A ragged white strip shows at the top-left and left edge (accepted).

Moses stretches his hand over the sea as the waters curl apart to leave a path, a pillar of pure flame on the horizon and the people watching. A small white unpainted patch sits at the bottom-left corner (accepted).

Peter in the foreground looks across the courtyard at bound Jesus, who faces him from the colonnade, with the brazier fire and soldiers between. The white at left is a whitewashed wall, not bare paper.
Jesus cries out with his arm toward the opened tomb as wrapped Lazarus steps out and the crowd recoils. The sky wash stops short of the top-right corner, leaving white paper (accepted).

Holmes kneels on the flags with lantern and lens, Merryweather sits aggrieved on a crate, Watson and the police agent stand by; crates are unmarked. Ragged white paper shows along the bottom and side edges (accepted).
The water arcs out of the shaft of Moses' raised rod through the air and falls into a stream at left, while the rock face behind him and Aaron is dry. People and animals drinking are otherwise right.
Daniel stands unharmed among calm, closed-mouthed lions, speaking up to the king at the rim, with a shaft of light and translucent wisps for the angel. No lettering, anatomy sound.

A newspaper pinned on the wall right of Watson has a masthead in letter-like forms, and the slip, the letters on the table and the mantel clock carry writing marks and numerals, all small and unreadable. Holmes rather than Watson holds the slip to the light; white paper shows at the left and top-right edges (accepted).
The man holds a knife over a fully shrouded, bound body on a table in a dark room. No blood, wound or nudity is shown; hands are sound.

Daniel watches ranks of white-robed attendants, streams of fire and a blinding burst of light with two flaming wheels to the right; no figure or human shape is in the light. No distinct throne is drawn, the blaze stands in for it; the wash reaches the edges.
